notes.title: ​​Game Update Notice - August 31​
notes.content: [p]​Thank you for your continued support of [i]Love Begins with Goodbye![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We have released an update to address some known issues, including achievement-related bugs and other improvements. Detailed adjustments include:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing the achievement ​[b]​"The Second Gem"​[/b]​ from being unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the unlocking logic for the ​[b]​"Full Chapter Exploration"​[/b]​ achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected text errors in certain options, subtitles, and events.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed occasional subtitle display issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mismatches between some options and their subsequent videos.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]We appreciate your feedback and support. notes.title: Game Update Notes for August 28
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for your love for "Love Begins with Goodbye"![/p][p align="start"]We have fixed some issues in the game and released an update.[/p][p align="start"]The update includes the following:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed the issue where subtitles were missing in some videos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where audio overlapped in some videos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text errors in some event names.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple text errors in subtitles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with incorrect options for "pouring tea" and "pouring water" for Luo Xue'er in Chapter 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the skip shortcut key "Q" was not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an erroneous node in Xue'er's route in Chapter 6 that led to the affection points settlement interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the "Treasure!" achievement could not be unlocked.[/p][p]Replaying the "There's a Reaction!" node in Chapter 2 will now unlock the achievement: "Treasure!"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect completion conditions for the exploration achievements in all six chapters.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]Thank you all for your support of "Love Begins with Goodbye"! If you encounter any bugs, please feel free to email our development team, and we will address them as soon as possible.[/p][p align="start"]Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Official Release: Love Begins with Goodbye!​
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, I’m Producer Wang. Today marks the official release of [i]Love Begins  with Goodbye[/i], a day I’ve been looking forward to just as much as all of you. It’s been a year and nine months since I typed the first word of the script on Christmas Day in 2023. The development process was full of challenges—far more than I had imagined. But together with my team, we overcame every single one of them.[/p][p align="start"]I also want to sincerely thank everyone for your patience. I’ve always been a huge fan of romance games—from [i]Tokimeki Memorial[/i], [i]Memories Off[/i], and [i]CLANNAD[/i], to [i]Ever17[/i], [i]LovePlus[/i], [i]To the Moon[/i], [i]Love Is All Around[/i], and [i]Study Steady[/i]. These games have brought me countless moments of joy, heartbeat, and emotion, which is exactly why I was inspired to create a romance-themed game of my own.[/p][p align="start"]And now, it’s finally here. I’m both nervous and excited, and I truly hope this game can bring players the same kind of experience I once had.[/p][p align="start"]It’s currently 1:22 AM here in Norway—time for me to get some sleep. By the time I wake up tomorrow, I imagine many of you will have already finished certain character routes. I can’t wait to hear your thoughts, and I’ll carefully read every piece of feedback, good or bad.[/p][p align="start"]Wishing my maiden work, [i]Love Begins with Goodbye[/i], brings you all a heart-fluttering romance journey![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584050/b681480801d95db52612b2dc1252cd177dee8d18.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Love Begins with Goodbye​​ launches Aug 27, 10 AM Beijing Time!​​
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]I’m Wang, the producer of [i]Love Begins with Goodbye[/i]. I’m excited to announce that the game is now officially set for release on ​[b]​August 27 at 10:00 AM Beijing Time​[/b]​![/p][p align="start"]After a lengthy review process, we’re finally able to bring the game to you. As this is largely a personal project of mine—though made possible with help from many talented collaborators—I’ll be handling most of the operations myself. That said, my experience with post-launch activities and promotions is fairly limited, so I’ll need some time to plan things out properly. For now, I hope you can simply enjoy the game. Updates regarding merchandise and events will be shared at a later date.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you all so much for your patience and ongoing support. If you end up enjoying the game, I’d be truly grateful if you could share your thoughts on the story and characters—it would mean a lot to me.[/p][p align="start"]Let’s meet on the 27th![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584050/b681480801d95db52612b2dc1252cd177dee8d18.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Delay Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, I’m Lao Wang, the producer of "Love Begins from Farewell." I regret to inform you that the game will not be released as scheduled due to pending approval. As a first-time game developer, I underestimated the complexity and timeline of the review process. To address this, I’ve created a detailed video explaining the situation, available on Douyin and Bilibili.[/p][p]Though delayed, the wait won’t be long—we’ll launch immediately once approved. Thank you for your ongoing support. The demo version has received valuable feedback and recognition from players, communities, and netizens alike, and I’m deeply grateful.[/p][p]While we await the launch, you’re welcome to join our official group. I’ll share real-time updates there and kick off activities like merchandise giveaways and signed photo lotteries—all hosted in the group. I’ll also post behind-the-scenes content about the game across video platforms.[/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your patience. Stay tuned for the official release![/p]

notes.title: Love Begins with Goodbye Demo Released!​
notes.content: [p]​Sorry for making you all wait so long! ​[b]​The demo version finally passed review yesterday and is now released for everyone to play!​[/b]​[/p][p]There are still many details to polish in this version, ​[b]​so we'd really appreciate your feedback and suggestions.​[/b]​ Go ahead and ​[b]​start your own love story now!​[/b][/p]
